en.title: Build a Team from Candidates at Both Ends
en.description:
In each round, pick the highest-scoring person from the union of the first k and the last k people in the remaining list, breaking ties by the smallest index; remove that person and continue until t people have been chosen. Find the sum of their scores. The original title's alternating between the two ends does not match the body text; the body text takes precedence.

The input/output protocol was compiled independently by this site; upstream solutions are not executed.
en.input: The first line contains n t k, and the second line contains n scores. The original text gives no numeric bounds; this site sets 1≤t,k≤n≤100000 and 1≤score≤10⁹.
en.output: Output the single integer required by the problem.
en.explanation: The answers to the three public examples are, in order: 9; 105; 6. All examples have been verified by independent small-scale enumeration or state search.
hints: Keep the candidates from both sides in one heap ordered by negative score and original index, and record which side each one came from; after popping, refill from the corresponding side with an element that has not been exposed yet.
